title: Settings
sub: How the app looks, who you're signed in as, and how to leave.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHint: Light or dark. Remembered on this device.
appearance.languageHint: English or Hebrew, across the whole app.

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.methodSession: You sign in with your email address and password.
account.methodCode: You're signed in with an invite code, remembered on this device.
account.methodDev: Local mode: the app is running without sign-in.
account.signOutHint: Signs you out on this device only. Your account, your data and your other devices are not affected.

password.hint: Changing your password signs you out on your other devices.
password.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

others.hint: Ends every other session on this account. This device stays signed in.
others.done: Your other devices were signed out.
others.error: Couldn't sign out your other devices. Please try again.

extension.title: Browser extension key
extension.body: The JobFinder browser extension signs in with this key. Paste it into the extension's options.
extension.copyError: Couldn't copy. Show the key and copy it by hand.
extension.loadError: Couldn't load the key. Please try again.
extension.rotateBody: Replacing the key switches the current one off right away, so the extension stops working until you paste in the new key.
extension.rotateBodyCode: This key is your invite code. Replacing it keeps this device signed in, but the extension and every other device that uses the code will need the new one.
extension.rotated: New key created. Paste it into the extension's options.
extension.rotateError: Couldn't replace the key. Please try again.
extension.adminNote: This is the admin key. It comes from the server's APP_ACCESS_CODE setting, so it is changed there, not here.

inbox.title: Gmail sync
inbox.body: Reads the replies employers send to your Gmail and keeps your tracker up to date: applications, interviews, rejections and offers.
inbox.inviteOnly: Gmail sync is invite-only for now. Ask to have your Gmail address added.
inbox.read1: Only mail that looks like a reply about a job: its sender, subject, date and a short preview.
inbox.read2: Job alerts and all other mail are skipped before any AI sees them. Replies our rules can't sort go to OpenAI to be classified.
inbox.read3: Read-only, and whole emails are never stored: we keep the sender, subject, date, a short preview and what we found.
inbox.lookBack: How far back to import replies
inbox.testing: While Gmail sync is in testing, Google asks you to reconnect every 7 days.
inbox.demoHint: Gmail isn't set up on this server, so this connects a demo mailbox of sample replies.
inbox.connectError: Couldn't start connecting. Please try again.
inbox.reconnectBy: Google asks you to reconnect every 7 days. Reconnect by {{date}}.
inbox.needsReauth: Google ended the connection, so syncing is paused. Reconnect to carry on where it stopped.
inbox.autoSyncHint: Twice a day, and whenever you open the tracker.
inbox.saveError: Couldn't save that. Please try again.
inbox.disconnectBody: Stops reading your mail and removes our access to it. Every card on your tracker stays.
inbox.purge: Also delete the emails we detected

callback.missingScope: Gmail access wasn't granted. On Google's screen, allow JobFinder to read your email, then try again.
callback.stateMismatch: That connection attempt expired or started in another browser. Start it again from here.
callback.accessDenied: You cancelled on Google's screen, so nothing was connected.
callback.noRefreshToken: Google didn't grant lasting access. In your Google Account, remove JobFinder from third-party access, then connect again.
callback.generic: Couldn't connect Gmail. Please try again.

alerts.title: Job alerts
alerts.body: Daily email alerts are set up on the Jobs page, next to your search.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.closeBody: This deletes everything above, closes your account and signs you out on every device. This can't be undone.
danger.closeError: Couldn't close your account. Please try again.
danger.closeAdminBlocked: This is the admin account for this instance — closing it would lock everyone out, including you. Delete all my data does the same wipe.
